{{Quote|I am General Kligton, commanding on the authority of the Sith Lord Rathari, appointed to Nar Shaddaa by the Dark Council! Why do you attack the Empire's men?|Kligton to Darth Baras' apprentice|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Kligton''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[General/Legends|general]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] he was stationed on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], commanding Empire's men under orders of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Rathari]]. During the assault on Republic [[Outpost Shylon]], his firefight with Republic's men under [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] [[Weggland]] was interrupted by arrival of [[Empire's Wrath|the apprentice]] of [[Darth Baras]], who was systematically dismantling Rathari's power base. The [[Sith Warrior]] ordered Kligton and his men to stand down, but the General choose to obey his standing orders and ordered an attack on the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], during which he was killed.
